words.tr: 这两件事同时发生。
words.full: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.alt: The two systems run simultaneously.
words.altZh: 两个系统同时运行。
words.cp: simultaneously with 与……同时｜simultaneous adj. 同时发生的

words.sent: The meeting ended ___ at noon.
words.tr: 会议在中午突然结束了。
words.full: The meeting ended abruptly at noon.
words.alt: He stopped abruptly and turned back.
words.altZh: 他突然停下并转过身。
words.cp: abruptly 强调“毫无预警地中断”｜abrupt adj. 突然的/唐突的

words.sent: He ___ left the country last week.
words.tr: 据说他上周离开了该国。
words.full: He allegedly left the country last week.
words.alt: The drug allegedly caused side effects.
words.altZh: 据说这种药引起了副作用。
words.cp: allegedly 常用于新闻报道，表示“据称”（尚未证实）｜allege v. 宣称

words.sent: She was ___ absent from the talks.
words.tr: 她明显缺席了会谈。
words.full: She was conspicuously absent from the talks.
words.alt: The report conspicuously omits the costs.
words.altZh: 这份报告明显漏掉了成本。
words.cp: conspicuously absent/silent 明显缺席/明显保持沉默（常见搭配）

words.sent: ___, cheap goods may cost more later.
words.tr: 相反，便宜货日后可能花费更多。
words.full: conversely, cheap goods may cost more later.
words.alt: Conversely, higher pay may reduce effort.
words.altZh: 相反，更高的报酬可能降低努力程度。
words.cp: conversely 用于引出相反情况，常置于句首｜converse adj./n. 相反的/反面

words.sent: Costs fell ___ last year.
words.tr: 去年成本大幅下降。
words.full: Costs fell drastically last year.
words.alt: The rules were drastically changed.
words.altZh: 这些规定被彻底修改了。
words.cp: drastically 强调“大幅度、彻底地”｜drastic adj. 激烈的

words.sent: The method is ___ risky.
words.tr: 这种方法本质上就有风险。
words.full: The method is inherently risky.
words.alt: Violence is inherently unstable.
words.altZh: 暴力本质上是不稳定的。
words.cp: inherently + 形容词，表示“本质上/固有地”｜inherent in 为……所固有

words.sent: Sales rose ___ in March.
words.tr: 三月份销售额略有上升。
words.full: Sales rose marginally in March.
words.alt: The figure is marginally higher than last year.
words.altZh: 这个数字比去年略高。
words.cp: marginally + 比较级，表示“略微”｜marginal adj. 微小的

words.sent: He will ___ arrive by noon.
words.tr: 他大概中午前会到。
words.full: He will presumably arrive by noon.
words.alt: She is presumably at home now.
words.altZh: 她现在大概在家。
words.cp: presumably 作评注性状语，表示据推测｜presume v. 推测

words.sent: The rules are ___ enforced here.
words.tr: 这里严格执行这些规定。
words.full: The rules are rigorously enforced here.
words.alt: Every claim is rigorously tested.
words.altZh: 每一项主张都经过严格检验。
words.cp: rigorously tested/checked 经严格检验｜rigorous adj. 严格的

words.sent: The panel agreed ___ to accept it.
words.tr: 小组一致同意接受它。
words.full: The panel agreed unanimously to accept it.
words.alt: They voted unanimously in favour.
words.altZh: 他们一致投票赞成。
words.cp: vote/agree unanimously 一致投票/同意｜unanimous adj. 一致同意的
